name: Biome
description: Formatter and linter for web languages.
summary: Biome allows AI-assisted contributions, including AI-generated code, tests and docs, but every use of AI assistance must be disclosed in the pull request together with the extent of that use. AI must not be used to write pull request descriptions or other contributor communication, and maintainers may close pull requests they believe contain AI-generated communication.

evidence.quote:
If you are using **any kind of AI assistance** to contribute to Biome,
> it must be disclosed in the pull request.

If you relied on AI assistance to make a pull request, you must disclose it in the
pull request, together with the extent of the usage.
Please be respectful to maintainers and disclose AI assistance.

For example, if you used
AI to generate docs or tests, you must say it.
Please do not use AI to write pull request descriptions or contributor communication for this project.
If we believe AI-generated communication was used, we may close the pull request at our discretion.
If we believe AI-generated communication was used, we may close the pull request at our discretion.
Repeated attempts to contest that decision in comments or re-open the PR may affect whether we accept future contributions from the same contributor.
